import redis
r=redis.Redis(port=6379); v=redis.Redis(port=6380)
for db in (0,2):
 r=redis.Redis(port=6379,db=db);v=redis.Redis(port=6380,db=db)

text: Copied the data from Redis 7.2 to Valkey 9.1 using replication, then promoted Valkey to a standalone, writable primary. I verified all 3,270 keys across both populated databases, including their types, values, expiration times, and stream consumer-group state. The current Redis server remains running, and I did not change its data.
